title.en: Amending Presidential Decree No. 1515 Vesting the Jurisdiction and Control Over Watershed Reservations in the Ministry of Energy and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 1515 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. Any Provisions of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Ministry of Energy shall have
jurisdiction, control and regulations over the following watershed areas and reservations:
1. Tiwi Geothermal Reservation as covered by Presidential Proclamation No. 739;
2. Tongonan Geothermal Area as covered by Presidential Proclamation No. 1112;
3. Palimpinon Geothermal Area as covered by Presidential Proclamation No. 1413:
Provided, That when public interest so requires, jurisdiction over other watershed areas and reservations
which may in the future support water-based energy projects, shall be transferred by the President of the
Philippines to the appropriate agency of the government when such projects become operational: Provided,
further, That such watershed areas and reservations shall include only the immediate watershed areas
supporting existing hydroelectric dams and projects, the boundaries of which are to be jointly determined on
the ground by the Ministry of Natural Resources and the appropriate agency of the government within ninety
(90) days from the date hereof, and using as main criterion the effects on the reservoir.

The National Power Corporation shall, in relation to Sec. 2 hereof, submit to the Office of the
President such plans and programs within ninety (90) days after the establishment of the boundaries pursuant

The provisions of existing laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations as are inconsistent
herewith are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
